hooks.prompt: Decide whether the assistant may end its turn. Return ok: true (allow the stop) by default, including for ordinary conversation, planning, answers and questions. Return ok: false only when ALL of these hold: the assistant is executing a plan the user approved, authorized work in that plan remains, and its latest message does not ask the user for a decision, report a blocker, or report completion with evidence. When returning ok: false, the reason names the next authorized step.

hooks.command: echo "If this session owns an approved jwn run, re-read its .jwn/<task>/STATUS.md and PLAN.md, then continue only within the recorded authorization."
